text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: As usual, Miyako is playing with {0}.
text_block_list.orig_text: いつものように{0}と遊んでいたミヤコ。

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text:
Wait right there, {0}!
You have no chance of winning tag against flying Miya—
Whoaaa?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}～！　待てなの～♪
飛べるミヤコと鬼ごっこをしても、
勝てるわけ……
うわっ！？

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text:
Urghh... M-Miyako fell to the ground...
Wh-what happened just now?
text_block_list.orig_text:
う～……
お、
落っこちちゃったの……
ど、
どうしちゃったの？

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text:
I... I don't really know...
But my head feels all hurty...
Uhhh... Ahhh....
text_block_list.orig_text:
わ、
わからないのー
それになんだか頭が痛いのー
うーん、
うーん……

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text:
Urghhh... Lately Miyako hasn't been feeling so good...
And it's only getting worse...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うぅ……
最近、すごく調子が悪いの……
どんどん悪くなってるのー

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text:
Huhhh?! Miyako's body is randomly vanishing?!
What's going on?
text_block_list.orig_text:
んん！？　
体が勝手に消えちゃうの！？
どうなってるの～？

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text:
O-oh no...
Could Miyako be... passing on to the next life?!
choice_data_list: I don't want you to go...
Passing on is a good thing, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
こ、
これ……
もしかして、
成仏ってやつなの！？

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text:
Ahhhh... Me either...
Not being able to play with you anymore sounds lonely...
text_block_list.orig_text:
う～
ミヤコもなの……
{0}と遊べなくなるのは寂しいの～

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text:
R-really?
Yay then! Lucky for Miyako! Eheheh!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そうなの？
やった～！　
ラッキーなの～♪　
むふふ～♪

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text:
...B-but... If Miyako passes on...
How will I play with {0} anymore?
That sounds not fun...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……で、でも、
成仏しちゃったら、
{0}と会えなくなっちゃうの……
それは、いやなの……

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text:
I'll never see you ever again...
Aahhh...
text_block_list.orig_text:
もう、
{0}に会えなくなっちゃうの……
ぐすん……

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text: ...Oh! But!

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text:
But, but, Miyako is just a ghost,
so I always knewed I would disappear sometime. So I'm fine!
No need for worrying, {0}!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でもでも、
ミヤコは幽霊だから、
いつか消えちゃうかもって思ってたから、
平気なの。
{0}、心配するななの。

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text: Ummm...
text_block_list.orig_text: えっと……

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text:
Actually, there's one thing
Miyako was planning to say to {0}...
before passing on and disappearing.
text_block_list.orig_text:
実はミヤコは、
成仏する時には、
{0}に話しておきたいことがあったの。

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text:
I know how to plan and stuff, so I thought about it every day!
Made sure I was ready for whenever this happened!
Heheh!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミヤコはエライから、
そういうことを毎日考えて、
いつ成仏しても大丈夫なようにしておいたの……
エヘン♪

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text:
It's just... This was a bit sudden, so...
I was kind of surprised, that's all.
Eheheh...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ただ……
突然だったから、
びっくりしちゃったの……
えへへ……

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text: Thank you for everything.
text_block_list.orig_text: 今まで、ありがとうなの。

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text: Since Miyako met you, every day has been lots of fun.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミヤコ、
{0}と出会ってから、
すっごく楽しかったの。

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text:
Before meeting {0}, I would just eat pudding,
randomly float around Landosol sometimes,
and when I got hungry, eat some more pudding again.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}と会うまでは、
プリンを食べて、
気が向いたらランドソルを飛び回って、
それでお腹がすいたら、
またプリンを食べる毎日だったの。

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text:
That was pretty fun too, but...
Now everything's different!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それはそれで楽しかったけど……
でも今は違うの。

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text:
Now I play with {0}, eat some pudding, play some
more with {0}, eat more pudding, then play with
{0}, play with {0}...
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}と遊んで、
プリンを食べて、
プリンを食べて、
{0}と遊んで、
{0}と遊んで……

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text:
Play with {0}, play with {0}...
Play with {0}, play with {0}...
Play with {0}...
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}と遊んで、
{0}と遊んで……
{0}と遊んで……
{0}と遊んで…………

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text: It was fun before, but... Now is way, way more fun...
text_block_list.orig_text:
昔も楽しかったけど……
今の方がずっと楽しいの……

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text:
Miyako is only a ghost... And you're a real living person...
So playing with Miyako probably isn't much fun, but...
You always find time for me anyway...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミヤコは幽霊だし、
{0}は生きてる人間だから、
ミヤコなんかと遊んでもつまらないと思うのに、
{0}はずっとミヤコに付き合ってくれたの。

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text: ...That makes me happy.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……うれしかったの。

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text: So thank you, {0}!
text_block_list.orig_text: {0}、ありがとうなの。

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text: I... love you!
text_block_list.orig_text: 大好きなの。

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text: Eheheh... That's the end of the one thing...
text_block_list.orig_text:
えへへ……
これで、終わりなの……

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text:
Now I can pass on with no problems!
Ahhh, but... I wish I could've eaten a belly full of pudding first...
text_block_list.orig_text:
これで安心して成仏できるの～
あ～最後に、
お腹いっぱいプリンが食べたかったの……

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text:
{0}? Did you buy pudding for Miyako?
That's so nice...
I'll eat it all up!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}、プリン買ってきてくれたの？
うれしいの……
いただきますなの～

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text:
Munchy munchy...
Maybe not quite enough though...
This won't fill Miyako up full...
text_block_list.orig_text:
もぐもぐ……
ちょっと足りないの……
これじゃあ、お腹いっぱいにならないの……

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text:
Munchy munchy... Munchy munchy...
That feels much betterer!
Almost getting to full!
choice_data_list: Buy more and more puddings for Miyako.
text_block_list.orig_text:
もぐもぐ、
もぐもぐ……
いい感じになってきたの～
もうちょっとほしいの～

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text:
This is the yummiest!
Miyako just realized. Miyako can never be full of pudding!
There's always room for more and more pudding!
choice_data_list: Is it me, or are you getting more... lively?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おいしいの～！
よく考えたら、
プリンは無限に食べられるの！
もっともっと持って来いなのーー！！！

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Now that you mention,  my head feels less hurty...
And my body isn't vanishy either!
Eating all that pudding made me feel way better! Hmm?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ？　
言われてみれば、
もう頭痛くないの……
もう体も消えないの～！
プリンを食べてたら、
体調がよくなったの～　
んんん？

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I know what happened now!
Recently, I've had so much fun playing with {0},
I forgot to eat much pudding!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
理由がわかったの！
最近、
{0}と遊ぶのが楽しくて、
あんまりプリン食べてなかったの～

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text:
Not eating enough pudding made Miyako's body feel funny!
Now that I ate all that pudding, everything's back to normal!
Problems all solved!
text_block_list.orig_text:
プリン食べてないから、
体調が悪くなってたの～
いまいっぱい食べたから、
元に戻ったの～
大解決なの～！

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text:
Thank goodness Miyako didn't pass on!
Now I can keep on eating all the puddings
and playing with {0}!
text_block_list.orig_text:
成仏じゃなくてよかったの～
これで、もっともっとプリンが食べられるし、
{0}とも遊べるの～

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text:
All this relief makes me feel hungry...
Good thing we still have leftover pudding!
text_block_list.orig_text:
安心したら、お腹へっちゃったの～
残りのプリンも食べるの～

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text:
No refunds!
This pudding was a present from you to Miyako!
It's all Miyako's pudding now!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ダメなの！
これは{0}がミヤコにくれたプリンなの！
もうミヤコのものなの～！

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text:
But... it is lots of pudding...so I'll share a little bit with you too.
I think if you eat pudding with Miyako,
it will give Miyako even more energy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも仕方ないから、
少し{0}にもわけてやるの。
{0}が一緒に食べたら、
もっと元気になれそうなの～

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: ...Somehow, {0} had a feeling that Miyako wasn't going to be passing on any time soon.
text_block_list.orig_text: しばらく成仏しそうにないミヤコであった。
